images.alt: A ground stone axe head hafted in a bent wooden handle bound with fibre, in a museum case
images.caption: A hafted stone axe from North Queensland in the Peabody Museum, Harvard University: a ground stone head set in a bent withy handle and bound, the pattern Roth recorded across the north.
images.credit: Photograph: Daderot, Wikimedia Commons (CC0); object in the Peabody Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology, Harvard University
